findings.claim: MWA FY2027 consolidated net sales guidance $1,440-1,470M (excluding metering) and adjusted EBITDA $378-388M
findings.excerpt: is introducing fiscal 2027 consolidated net sales guidance of $1,440 million to $1,470 million. This guidance excludes all metering-related financial results. In fiscal 2026, the metering-related net sales were approximately $40 million. The Company anticipates its fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA to be between $378 million and $388 million.

findings.claim: MWA expects resilient municipal repair and replacement demand driven by aging water infrastructure, moderated by municipal budget pressure; 60-65% of FY2025 sales tied to municipal repair/replacement
findings.excerpt: We estimate approximately 60% to 65% of our fiscal 2025 net sales were associated with the repair and replacement of municipal water infrastructure, approximately 25% to 30% were related to residential construction activity and approximately 10% were related to natural gas utilities
